news.headline: Vassell provided 12 points (4-10 FG, 2-6 3Pt, 2-3 FT), five rebounds, four assists and one steal in 36 minutes during Tuesday's 105-93 loss to Detroit.
news.story: Vassell had one of his better showings of late after struggling through a cold stretch in his previous two games. His outside shot has been inconsistent all season, and he is hitting just over 31 percent from deep. San Antonio leans on him as a two-way wing, and his perimeter defense keeps him on the floor even when his shot isn't falling.

news.headline: Devin Vassell finishes around multiple Pistons defenders
Vassell (groin) is available for Friday's game against Golden State.
news.story: Vassell has been cleared to suit up and should provide San Antonio with a reliable perimeter scoring option against the Warriors. Through 10 games, he's averaging 11.9 points, 3.8 rebounds and 3.1 assists.
